items.prompt: Sketch the paths of an electron, a proton and a neutron entering horizontally between a positive upper plate and a negative lower plate. Label the plates and paths. Directions only; no scale is required.
items.canonical_answer:
![Labelled directions of electron, proton and neutron paths](assets/8224-electric-field.png)
Electron towards the positive upper plate; proton towards the negative lower plate; neutron straight. Deflection starts upon entering the field. At equal entry speeds the electron bends more strongly; the drawing is not quantitatively to scale.
marking_guidance: Required labels: plate signs and all three particles. Bonds or axes: horizontal entry direction, with arrows on paths. Unambiguous representation: electron upwards, proton downwards, neutron straight.
items.provenance: Original visual pilot for the approved Chemistry plan.
